issues.description: CHANGELOG entry name does not match the actual check identifier
issues.detail: The CHANGELOG lists `compute_image_not_publicly_shared` but the PR title/description says `compute_image_publicly_shared`. The directory and class use `compute_image_not_publicly_shared`. Pick one canonical name; an inconsistency here will haunt search, docs, and downstream tooling. Loop-invariant for naming: the CheckID, directory, class, and CHANGELOG must be identical strings.

issues.description: Per-image getIamPolicy yields O(N) sequential RPCs with no concurrency
issues.detail: `_get_images` iterates images and issues one `getIamPolicy` call each, serially, inside a per-project loop. Other collectors in this same file use `__threading_call__`. For projects with many images the wall-clock is N * RTT. The algorithm is asymptotically fine but the constants kill it; reuse the existing threaded helper.

issues.description: IAM-policy exception is swallowed and silently treated as not-public
issues.detail: When `getIamPolicy` raises (e.g., permission denied, as test-image-3 simulates), the code logs and proceeds with `publicly_shared=False`. That is an unproven assumption: the image could be public but unreadable to the caller. Either surface as UNKNOWN/MANUAL or skip the resource. A FAIL check that defaults to PASS on error is the wrong failure mode for a security tool.

issues.description: Loop invariant for `publicly_shared` is not stated and depends on substring-style membership
issues.detail: The inner loop sets `publicly_shared=True` and breaks on the first binding containing `allAuthenticatedUsers`. The invariant ('publicly_shared is true iff some binding grants any role to allAuthenticatedUsers') should be a one-line comment. Also consider role allow-listing: a binding that grants `roles/viewer` vs `roles/compute.imageUser` may matter for severity, though the current scope of 'any role' is defensible if documented.

issues.description: Service test asserts `id.__class__.__name__ == 'str'` instead of `isinstance(..., str)`
issues.detail: Idiomatic and readable form is `isinstance(image.id, str)`. The current form is opaque and brittle to subclassing. Tests are documentation for the data structure; write them for the reader.

issues.description: Image listing does not filter custom-only images; risks pulling Google's public catalog
issues.detail: `images().list(project=project_id)` on the user's project returns the project's own images, which is correct, but the description claims 'custom images only' without a stated filter or invariant. Add a one-line comment establishing why project-scoped list suffices (Google-managed images live in separate projects) so future readers don't 'fix' it by adding cross-project enumeration.

review.summary: UNDER-AUDITED with one NEEDS-LITERATE-COMMENT and one ASYMPTOTICALLY-OK-PRACTICALLY-SLOW finding. The algorithm is straightforward (scan images, inspect IAM bindings, flag allAuthenticatedUsers) and the tests cover the three relevant cases, but the loop invariant is never stated and the per-image IAM call is serialized while sibling collectors in the same file use threading. The most consequential rigor gap is silent error-swallowing: a getIamPolicy failure currently defaults to PASS, which is the wrong direction for a security check. A naming inconsistency between CHANGELOG and the actual CheckID should be reconciled before merge.
